name: clean
label: Clean
css: .style-clean { background-color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--text, #111827); font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 64px; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; } .style-clean .hook { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -1px; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 85%; word-wrap: break-word; } .style-clean .text { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 90%; word-wrap: break-word; } .style-clean .step { position: absolute; top: 64px; right: 64px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; color: var(--text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; margin: 0; } .style-clean .brand { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; text-transform: capitalize; } .style-clean::before { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6), transparent); opacity: 0.2; } .slide-code.style-clean { background-color: var(--code-bg, #1F2937); color: var(--code-text, #F3F4F6); } .slide-code.style-clean .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); } .slide-code.style-clean .text { color: var(--code-text, #F3F4F6); } .slide-code.style-clean .step { color: var(--code-text, #F3F4F6); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-clean .brand { color: var(--code-text, #F3F4F6); } .slide-code.style-clean::before { background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6), transparent); opacity: 0.3; } .slide-insight.style-clean { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, var(--secondary, #8B5CF6) 100%); color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); } .slide-insight.style-clean .hook { color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); } .slide-insight.style-clean .text { color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); } .slide-insight.style-clean .insight-text { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); margin: 24px 0 0 0; max-width: 90%; } .slide-insight.style-clean .step { color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-clean .brand { color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); } .slide-insight.style-clean::before { background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--surface, #FFFFFF), transparent); opacity: 0.2; }
